questions.stem: We define \(a \oplus b = ab + a + b\). If \(3 \oplus 5 = 2 \oplus x\), what is the value of \(x\)?
questions.hint: Evaluate the left side first using the rule (\(3 \oplus 5 = 3 \times 5 + 3 + 5 = 23\)), write the right side as \(2x + 2 + x = 3x + 2\), and solve \(3x + 2 = 23\)!

steps.explain: Evaluate the left-hand side \(3 \oplus 5\) using \(a \oplus b = ab + a + b\) with \(a = 3, b = 5\).
Write the right-hand side \(2 \oplus x\) with \(a = 2, b = x\) and simplify.
Set both sides equal and solve for \(x\): \(3x + 2 = 23 \implies 3x = 21 \implies x = 7\).
